property_summary: For any order filled via fillOrder, the reference contract always stores the position expiration under the long position's id when order.isLong is true and under the short position's id when order.isLong is false (i.e. it sets positionExpirations[ order.isLong ? uint256(orderHash) : positionId ] = block.timestamp + duration); the mutant instead always writes to positionExpirations[positionId] which for some inputs (when order.isLong is true) causes a different mapping key to be set and thus a differing getter value.
change_summary: Move the assignment to positionExpirations so that it always writes using positionId (oppositeOrder hash) instead of using the conditional that sometimes writes using orderHash; this changes which key is set after fillOrder.
